title: Chain-level restriction formula for Koszul Hom comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\geq0$, $f:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to A$, $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $U=\bigcup_jD(f_j)$, and let $I_e$, the structure object $O$, and the augmentation $u_e:I_e\to O$ be [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Specify the derived categories required to form derived restriction $R$ to $U$ and module derived sections. Let $F$ be a termwise quasi-coherent integer cochain complex of module sheaves on $X$, $E\in D_{QCoh}(X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $e_F:Q(F)\simeq E$. Put $M=\Gamma(X,F)$ and let $s:T(M)\simeq F$ be an isomorphism whose component in every degree is the canonical tilde/global-section counit. Let $D$ be the module Koszul Hom diagram, $C$ its colimit, $j_e:D_e\simeq\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_A(L_e,M)$ its specified object isomorphism for the extended module tail $L_e$, and let $\beta:H^0(C)\to H^0(R\Gamma_A(U,E))$ be the localization/homology comparison inverse followed by the canonical Koszul-to-Cech-derived-sections comparison and $R\Gamma_A(U,e_F)$ [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. There is an additive equivalence $b:\operatorname{Hom}(R(O),R(E))\simeq H^0(R\Gamma_A(U,E))$ such that for every $e$, chain map $g:L_e\to M$, cycle $z$ whose inclusion is $\operatorname{ofHom}(g)$, and arrow $\psi:R(O)\to R(E)$ satisfying $R(u_e)\circ\psi=R(Q(Tg)\circ Q(s)\circ e_F)$, one has $b(\psi)=\beta(H^0(\iota_e)(H^0(j_e^{-1})(\pi(z))))$.

proof.text: Use evaluation at one for derived Hom from the structure sheaf on U. Identify the restricted chosen structure object with that structure sheaf and restrict scalars from Gamma(U,O_U) to A. This gives the additive equivalence b; postcompose along e_F to give its target E.

Use the cocone formula on the actual chain map g: on the intersection J its value is evaluation on the ordered exterior basis, divided by the generator product to exponent e+1, with the specified totalization sign. The canonical counit condition on s identifies this with the sheaf evaluation of Tg. On D(f_j), exterior multiplication by the jth generator divided by f_j^(e+1) contracts the full Koszul complex. Applying the chain-map identity to that contraction shows that inverse augmentation followed by Tg has exactly these localized values, including the signs. Agreement on intersections and the Cech-derived comparison give the equality in derived sections. The equation imposed on psi determines this inverse-augmentation composite, by lem-sc-affine-perfect-koszul-principal-unit-iso at exponent e+1, since its shifted tail and augmentation agree with the open-system definitions and the subsequent overEquiv preserves isomorphisms.

Pass the equality to H^0. The condition on z identifies its projection pi(z) with the class of g; j_e inverse transports it to D_e, and the cocone leg factors as comparison composed with iota_e. The inverse localization/homology comparison gives exactly beta as displayed. Evaluation at one yields b(psi). For r=0, zero ring, F=0, and g=0 the same constructions are zero and the formula holds.

theorem koszulChain_restriction_formula
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (eF : DerivedCategory.Q.obj F ≅ E.obj)
    (s : ((koszulOpenTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F) ≅ F)
    (hs : ∀ n : ℤ, s.hom.f n = Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of A) (F.X n)) :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let M := ((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F
    let D := koszulCechHomDiagram A r f M
    let C := koszulCechHomColimit A r f M
    let β := ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).app C).inv ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).map
        (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F ≫
          (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor.map eF.hom)
    ∃ b : (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E.obj) ≃+
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
          ((affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E.obj),
      ∀ (e : ℕ)
        (g : (koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶ M)
        (z : (CochainComplex.moduleHomComplex
          ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) M).cycles 0),
        (CochainComplex.moduleHomComplex
          ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) M).iCycles 0 z =
            CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom g →
        ∀ ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E.obj,
          R.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) ≫ ψ =
            R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
              (((koszulOpenTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g) ≫
                DerivedCategory.Q.map s.hom ≫ eF.hom) →
          b ψ = β (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (colimit.ι D e) 0
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (koszulCechHomObjIso A r f M e).inv 0
              ((CochainComplex.moduleHomComplex
                ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) M).homologyπ
                  0 z)))
